purpose: Document first-party discovery, current viewer/configuration inspection, bounded anonymous requests, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: The official municipal citizen portal is live and its current configuration points to Campina Grande public-service APIs. Its map is for public equipment/locations, not cadastral parcels. The municipal property-debt page is an owner/tax workflow requiring matrícula and CPF/CNPJ, so no request was made. No qualifying parcel geometry was obtained.
registryAssessment: Municipal property-service pages evidence a municipal property-tax/property-certificate function, but not a public cadastral map or a specifically identified local registry custodian. registryFound remains null.
